# Command-line reference

**Audience:** operators. Every command and option of the `ferropix` and
`ferropix-console` binaries, as `<binary> <command> --help` prints it.
[Configuration](../operate/configuration.md) describes the configuration
every command reads, and a refused configuration exits 78 (`EX_CONFIG`).

<!-- toc -->

## The server

### `ferropix`

```text
The FerroPIX Master Patient Index over IHE PIXm and PDQm

Usage: ferropix [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  serve        Serves until the process is asked to stop
  config       Works on the configuration
  healthcheck  Asks the server running beside this process whether it is ready, and exits 0 only when it is
  db           Works on the database
  matching     Works on the matching
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `ferropix config`

```text
Works on the configuration

Usage: ferropix config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  check  Reads the configuration, reports every refusal with its key, and prints the running tree with every secret redacted
  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

### `ferropix db`

```text
Works on the database

Usage: ferropix db [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  migrate  Applies the pending migrations and the `[[domain]]` seed, and exits
  reseal   Rewrites every sealed identifier column under the key `[db] data_key_file` names, reading the old key from its own file
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
